
# mybrandplease

> mybrandplease (NIMISHA IMPEX WORLDWIDE (P) LIMITED) is a private label and third-party cosmetics manufacturer based in Greater Noida, India, with offices in the USA, Canada, and Australia. Founded in 2005, the company has 21+ years of experience manufacturing skin care, hair care, body care, bathing soaps, and men's grooming products for brands worldwide. Facilities are FDA registered, ISO 22716 certified, and MoCRA compliant.

## Company
- Legal name: NIMISHA IMPEX WORLDWIDE (P) LIMITED
- Founded: 2005
- Headquarters: D226, 10th Avenue, Gaur City 2, Greater Noida West, 201301, India
- Contact: info@mybrandplease.com | +91-97170-04615
- Certifications: FDA Registered, ISO 22716, MoCRA Compliant, EU CosIng Compliant, Cruelty-Free, Vegan Certified, CPNP Registered

## Core Services
- [Private Label Manufacturing](https://mybrandplease.com/): Custom-branded skin care, hair care, body care, and grooming products with minimum order quantities starting at 500 units
- [Custom Formulation](https://mybrandplease.com/faqs/): Bespoke product formulations starting at $675, minimum 25 gallons, 8-12 week lead time
- [Product Samples](https://mybrandplease.com/): Available in 1/2 oz, 1 oz, and 2 oz sizes, shipped within 3-4 business days
- [Label & Logo Design](https://mybrandplease.com/faqs/): Logo design ($300) and label design ($350), one-time fee
